description: The lowest fire class or listing a country asks for in a kind of building or space (escape route, general area, high-rise, tunnel, hospital, data centre, plenum, riser, railway) for DE, ES, FR, GB, IT, TR and US: the rule lines with their sources and seen levels, makers' declarations marked as such, the US NEC listing ladders (CMP, CMR, CL3P ...), or not_found with the reason. Use it to choose the fire class to ask for; to read the class a designation prints use decode_cable_code (cpr_printed). Free, deterministic, no LLM.

country.description: ISO country code of the installation.

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages; default en.

place.description: The kind of building or space: escape (escape route), general, highrise, tunnel, hospital, datacentre, plenum, riser or railway.

name: fire_class
title: Lowest fire class or listing a country asks for
